name: Transfer Function Reconstruction Loss
definition: A loss function for optimizing the Transfer Function (TF) to match reference images, combining an L1 image loss and a smoothing prior on the TF.
summary: Transfer Function Reconstruction Loss optimizes a parametric transfer function to match reference images using L1 pixel-wise loss and a smoothing prior, differing from direct design by being data-driven and from peak-prediction by optimizing the entire shape.
